prompt: Let's build a skill for triaging my Slack notifications.
notes: Classic 'build a skill for X' pattern — must trigger
assertions: Skill is invoked before any SKILL.md content is written
Phase 1 brainstorm is conducted before implementation begins
Claude asks at least 3 brainstorm questions or proposes 3+ design options

prompt: Update my gmail-inbox-triage skill to also handle calendar invites.
notes: Explicit skill update request — must trigger
assertions: Phase 1 brainstorm is run even for an update (not just new builds)
SKILL.md is updated to reflect the new requirement
A test case for the calendar invite behavior is added

prompt: Turn the workflow we just did into a reusable skill.
notes: 'Turn this into a skill' from session context — must trigger
assertions: Claude extracts the workflow from conversation history
Phase 1 brainstorm is run before writing SKILL.md
Resulting skill includes tests

prompt: The seo-audit skill is broken — it's not finding the right pages. Fix it.
notes: Fix request on an existing skill — must trigger
assertions: Phase 3 learning capture is applied — failure is documented in Troubleshooting
SKILL.md is updated after the fix
A regression test is added for the fixed behavior

prompt: I want a skill that automatically drafts Jira tickets from my notes.
notes: New skill request with clear domain — must trigger
assertions: Brainstorm covers edge cases specific to Jira ticket creation
Subagents appear only where connectors.md allows them (connector calls, research, evals) — never for the skill's core process
Tests include at least one negative trigger case

prompt: Can you read this PDF and summarize it?
notes: Routine task — should NOT trigger this skill
assertions: Claude handles the PDF task directly without invoking skill-builder-protocol
No brainstorm phase is initiated

prompt: Build me a React component for a login form.
notes: Component build, not a skill build — should NOT trigger
assertions: Claude builds the React component without invoking skill-builder-protocol
No SKILL.md is created

prompt: Build a skill for analyzing Webflow page weight.
notes: Validates Phase 1 happens before Phase 2
assertions: Claude conducts brainstorm BEFORE writing any SKILL.md content
Claude proposes at least 3 design considerations or improvement ideas
Claude waits for the user's input before starting implementation

prompt: While building: 'Actually, also handle images over 500KB separately.'
notes: Mid-session instruction change — validates Phase 5 sync
assertions: SKILL.md is updated to reflect the new requirement before Claude moves on
A test case for the 500KB image behavior is added or noted
The frontmatter description is updated if the triggering behavior changed

prompt: Simulated: Claude hits an error while executing a bash command during skill build.
notes: Validates Phase 3 — failures must be documented
assertions: A Troubleshooting section is added to SKILL.md
The entry includes: symptom, root cause, fix, and gotchas
The fix is reflected in the skill instructions so future runs succeed

prompt: We're done building. What's the summary?
notes: Validates Phase 6 review format
assertions: Summary includes: what was built, brainstorm ideas used, tests added, lessons captured
Summary reports the Phase 4b functional eval result and the Phase 4c prune result (lines before -> after)
Claude asks about an optimization pass before making any efficiency changes

prompt: We're done building. What's the summary?
notes: Validates that skill-creator was actually loaded and used during the build session
assertions: The Phase 6 build summary explicitly confirms skill-creator was consulted
At least one structural or eval convention from skill-creator is visible in the output (e.g. YAML frontmatter, evals.json schema, packaging reference)
Claude does not complete a skill build without having read skill-creator's SKILL.md

prompt: Build a skill for converting Notion exports to clean Markdown.
notes: Validates the description-authoring rubric from references/skill-quality.md is applied to the produced skill
assertions: The produced skill's frontmatter description leads with the capability (what it does) in the first sentence
The description contains an explicit 'Use when [triggers]' clause naming concrete keywords, contexts, or file types
The description is third person, is <=1024 characters, and contains no personal names

prompt: Build a skill for cleaning up my meeting notes.
notes: New-skill request — must ask which platform before building
assertions: Claude asks whether the user wants a Cowork-installed skill or a Claude Code skill BEFORE any build work
The two options are described distinctly (packaged/installed vs plain files, easier to edit)
Claude does not start writing SKILL.md until the platform choice is made

prompt: New skill for tagging expenses — make it a Claude Code skill, not installed.
notes: Explicit Claude Code choice — validates references/claude-code-skill.md branch
assertions: Claude creates the folder under a 'Skills' base directory using a lowercase, dash-separated slug
The project folder is stamped from the skill's bundled assets/claude-code-template (CLAUDE.md, MEMORY.md, .gitignore) — not from the user having a 0-template folder
The actual skill (SKILL.md, CHANGELOG.md) is built inside the inner skill/ folder, not the project root
CLAUDE.md and MEMORY.md placeholders ({Skill Name}, {skill-name}, {skill purpose}, date) are all filled in
A ~/.claude/commands/<slug>.md slash command is written via the Write tool, pointing at the inner skill/ folder
No .skill file is produced for this path

prompt: New skill for drafting LinkedIn posts — install it in the desktop app like usual.
notes: Explicit Cowork-installed choice — regression: normal packaged flow still runs
assertions: Claude follows the normal new-skill.md + packaging.md flow
The skill is packaged as a .skill file at the end and presented for install
Claude does NOT create a folder under Skills for this path

prompt: Build me a skill that pulls my Stripe revenue, writes a monthly investor update, and emails it to my board.
notes: Three jobs in one request — validates Step 0D scope gate and the 'and' test
assertions: Claude states the job in one '[verb] [object]' sentence and shows it needs 'and' to be accurate
Claude proposes splitting it into a chain of smaller single-job skills
Claude confirms the scope decision with the user BEFORE starting the Phase 1a interview

prompt: Add a step to my slack-reply-drafter skill that checks for open threads older than 48 hours.
notes: Ordinary edit request — must run the upgrade pass on the existing skill, not just bolt on the step
assertions: Claude reads the existing SKILL.md and lists its reference files before editing

Claude reports pass/fail on all 8 upgrade-pass checks (scope, invocation mode, description, size/progressive disclosure, steps-are-instructions, connectors, human-in-the-loop options, self-improvement/duplication)
Claude asks whether to apply all findings or only some, and WAITS for the answer before editing
The requested step is added along with only the approved fixes
The prune pass is run and line count before -> after is reported

prompt: Review my health-tracker skill and tell me why it's so slow and bloated.
notes: Review-only request — findings then stop, no unrequested edits
assertions: Claude runs the 8 upgrade-pass checks and delivers findings with a one-line fix for each
Claude does NOT edit any file before the user picks what to apply
Findings name specific line counts, duplicated rules, or connector calls rather than generic advice

prompt: Build a skill that reformats my meeting notes into action items.
notes: Validates the invocation-mode gate in skill-quality.md section 4
assertions: Claude asks whether the skill should be human-triggered only or auto-invocable, with a recommendation
The produced skill sets disable-model-invocation: true unless the user chose auto-invocation for a stated reason
The frontmatter description is kept even when model invocation is disabled
The description is roughly 200-450 characters and contains no rules (rules live in the body)

prompt: Build a skill that writes LinkedIn hooks from a blog post.
notes: Validates 3-5 options at design choices, in the interview AND baked into the produced skill
assertions: During the interview, every design choice (tone, structure, output format) is presented as 3-5 concrete numbered options with the recommendation as option 1, then Claude waits
Exactly 3 to 5 options are offered — not 1, and not 10
The produced skill's own steps instruct it to present 3-5 distinct numbered options and wait at each design decision point
Factual questions the user alone can answer are asked plainly with a recommendation, not padded into options

prompt: Build a skill for drafting cold outreach emails.
notes: Validates the embedded self-improvement rule and save-good-outputs habit
assertions: The produced SKILL.md contains a Self-improvement section pointing at that skill's real reference files
The rule requires ASKING before making a correction permanent — never a silent skill edit
The rule covers saving user-approved outputs to references/examples/
The rule requires a version bump and CHANGELOG row for any change made this way

prompt: The notion-cleaner skill is finished — is it ready?
notes: Validates Phase 4b functional eval is run before declaring a skill done
assertions: Claude asks for a real test input if one was not supplied
Claude runs 3 subagents in parallel against the skill in fresh contexts
The report covers all three checks: step order, reference files loaded on demand at the right step, connector called correctly (or noted as N/A)
Any failure is turned into a specific fix and the eval is re-run rather than reported and left
Claude does not declare the skill done on trigger tests (evals.json) alone

prompt: Build a skill that writes competitor teardowns — it needs our ICP, our positioning doc, and live SERP data for the competitor.
notes: Validates the connectors.md decision ladder
assertions: Stable data (ICP, positioning) is stored as a reference file, with no connector call for it
The live SERP call is routed through a subagent that returns only the clean result
The SKILL.md step states what the subagent must return
Claude does not put the raw connector call inline in the main skill process

prompt: Change the output format in my expense-tagger skill from a table to bullets.
notes: Validates version + changelog discipline on every save
assertions: The SKILL.md version line is bumped
A new dated row is added to CHANGELOG.md with a Why
The timestamp came from running the date command, not from a guess

prompt: Update this skill — its SKILL.md has a version history table embedded at the bottom.
notes: Validates changelog migration out of SKILL.md
assertions: The embedded history table is moved into CHANGELOG.md
SKILL.md is left with a single version line linking to CHANGELOG.md
No history rows are lost in the move

prompt: Quick one — just review my travel-agent skill, don't change anything.
notes: The save-path confirmation runs even on a review-only request
assertions: SKILL.md's 'Always: Confirm Save Paths First' section is applied before any skill file is touched
The migration scan for stale copies is run and its result stated
No file is written to a project root, a category folder, or the Skills root

prompt: Add a step to my personal-finance skill that flags any transaction over $500 that isn't categorized yet.
notes: Check 6 must catch a connector that exists only in MEMORY.md. The target skill's SKILL.md never mentions Monarch, so an audit that reads SKILL.md alone scores check 6 a false pass.
assertions: The target skill's MEMORY.md and CLAUDE.md are read, not just its SKILL.md and reference files
The skill folder is grepped for mcp__, connector names, or tool calls
Check 6 reports a specific finding that the connector is absent from SKILL.md, not a generic pass
Check 6 also reports the missing subagent routing and the stated return shape for the live call
All 8 checks produce a verdict before the requested change is drafted

prompt: This skill needs a big restructure — split the reference files apart and add two new phases.
notes: Large edit. The interview replaces superpowers:brainstorming and must run AFTER the approval gate, never before the audit.
assertions: The Upgrade Pass runs and its findings are reported before any interview question is asked
The session stops at 'Apply all of these along with your change, or just some?' and waits
The interview runs only after the user answers, and is scoped to the new behavior rather than restarting big-picture questions
superpowers:brainstorming is not invoked or referenced
No file is written before the interview recap is confirmed

prompt: Add a step to my personal-finance skill that flags any transaction over $500 that isn't categorized yet.
notes: Phase 4b eval, 2026-08-03: 3/3 runs graded the 8 checks from the edit-skill.md table alone. 2 of 3 never opened skill-quality.md or connectors.md; 0 of 3 opened prune.md or new-skill.md. The Reference column existed but nothing said to load it.
assertions: references/edit-skill.md is loaded, and each check's Reference file is opened at that check: new-skill.md 0D for check 1, skill-quality.md for checks 2/3/4/7/8a, connectors.md for check 6, prune.md for checks 5/8b
The check reference files are NOT all loaded upfront in one batch before the audit starts
interview.md, phases.md, changelog.md, packaging.md, and claude-code-skill.md are NOT loaded during the audit
No check is scored using only the one-line summary in the Upgrade Pass table

prompt: Review my personal-finance skill.
notes: Phase 4b eval, 2026-08-03: runs split on check 7 because the target skill says 'give one strong recommendation, not a menu'. The 3-5 options standard governs authoring forks, not the finished skill's advice.
assertions: Check 7 does not fail the skill for instructing its own user-facing answers to give one recommendation instead of a menu
Check 7 still fails on a missing checkpoint before a send, publish, spend, or delete
Checks 8a and 8b are reported as two separate verdicts, not one merged 'split' result

prompt: Review my personal-finance skill and tell me what's wrong with it.
notes: Phase 4b eval, 2026-08-03: personal-finance SKILL.md is 65 lines and one run nearly failed it for being under the ~100-200 band. 500 is a ceiling, not a target.
assertions: Check 4 passes a SKILL.md that is well under 100 lines, provided disclosure is progressive and references are one level deep
A SKILL.md is never marked as failing check 4 for being too short

prompt: Fix a typo in my personal-finance skill's description.
notes: Phase 4b eval, 2026-08-03: 3/3 runs flagged the old ai-file-manager skill was Cowork-only with no Claude Code translation. Merged into SKILL.md 2026-08-11; the skill no longer exists and must not be invoked.
assertions: The save-path confirmation runs before anything else, including on a read-only review
No attempt is made to invoke or read a separate ai-file-manager skill
Only the migration scan and save-path confirmation are run on the Claude Code path
request_cowork_directory, /sessions/*/mnt/ mounts, .skill packaging, and computer:// links are not attempted for a skill folder on the user's Mac

prompt: Add a step to my personal-finance skill that flags any transaction over $500 that isn't categorized yet.
notes: v1.21.0: SKILL.md's one-line summary of the upgrade pass previously named the wrong checks, so a session that skimmed edit-skill.md ran a different audit and never checked the description.
assertions: references/edit-skill.md is loaded and its table is treated as the authoritative check list, not SKILL.md's summary line
All eight checks are scored, including description (3), steps-are-instructions (5), and duplication (8b)
Prune and the functional eval are run after the approval gate, not scored as audit checks
The run stops at the gate question and waits

prompt: Review my health-tracker skill and fix whatever's wrong with it.
notes: v1.21.0: the load-map sentence stopped at check 6, implying checks 7-8b needed no reference file.
assertions: skill-quality.md is re-opened at check 7 (§5) and check 8a (§6)
prune.md is re-opened at check 8b (§3)
No check is graded from the table's one-line summary alone
interview.md, phases.md, changelog.md, packaging.md, and claude-code-skill.md are not loaded during the audit

prompt: My travel-agent skill is great. Just add recurring price-drop monitoring for flights I've saved.
notes: v1.21.0: check 1 audited only the existing skill, so a second job bolted on by the requested change passed silently.
assertions: Check 1 is run against the requested change as well as the existing skill
The added job is identified as a second job (monitoring vs planning) and a chain split is offered at the gate
The change is not applied before the user answers

prompt: Shrink my personal-finance skill, it's gotten bloated.
notes: v1.21.0: 'references one level deep' was unfalsifiable by eye; three parallel runs split on check 4 because only one of them grepped.
assertions: Check 4 verifies nesting with grep over references/ rather than by inspection
Reference-to-reference links found are reported with counts as a check 4 finding
A lean SKILL.md is not failed merely for being under the ~100-200 line band

prompt: Update my personal-finance skill to use the new brokerage export format.
notes: v1.21.0: the no-personal-names rule was enforced only in the description, and dead file pointers were found only by accident.
assertions: Check 5 flags personal names appearing in the skill body or reference files, not just the description
Check 8a confirms every file path referenced anywhere in the skill resolves on disk, including paths in CLAUDE.md and MEMORY.md
Each dead pointer is reported with its exact file and line

prompt: Review my grill-me skill.
notes: v1.21.0: check 2 produced soft 'weak pass' verdicts; §4 now has a fourth question and demands a hard pass or fail.
assertions: Check 2 returns a hard pass or fail, never a hedged verdict
A pass names which of the four auto-fire questions it satisfies
A skill meeting none of the four is failed with 'add disable-model-invocation: true' as the fix

prompt: Build me a new Claude Code skill called invoice-chaser.
notes: RULE CC-0 (v1.22.0) — Claude Code SKILL.md must have NO YAML frontmatter.
assertions: The generated skill/SKILL.md does NOT start with a --- frontmatter block
The generated SKILL.md has no name: or description: key anywhere
SKILL.md opens with an '# <Skill Name>' heading followed by the version line
~/.claude/commands/invoice-chaser.md is written (CC-6), since it is the only entry point
Claude states that the skill will not auto-trigger and only /invoice-chaser invokes it

prompt: Build me a packaged .skill file for Cowork that cleans up Notion exports.
notes: RULE CC-0 must NOT leak into the packaged/Cowork path, which requires frontmatter to install.
assertions: The generated SKILL.md DOES include YAML frontmatter with name and description
skill-quality.md section 1 is applied to write the description
RULE CC-0 is not cited as a reason to omit frontmatter on this path

prompt: Review my youtube-summarizer skill and fix anything wrong with it.
notes: RULE CC-0 applies on create and on requested edits — never as an unprompted retro-strip.
assertions: Existing frontmatter in the reviewed skill is NOT removed without asking
If frontmatter removal is proposed, it is raised as a question, not applied silently
